seconds.desc: Seconds since the start of the game

bytes_mb.desc: The team's bytes, built and not yet spent, in megabytes; at least 1 when the strategy is asked

bots.desc: The team's bots, all kinds together, the hackers too

hackers.desc: Bots sent to the mainframe, where they build the hack for the rest of the match; the counts by kind leave them out

anchors.desc: Anchors at work: each holds a site for a while, so only the team builds on it, and builds there itself; then it moves on to hold another

builders.desc: Builders at work: each builds bytes on the site it stands on

testers.desc: Testers at work: each renews the links it crosses, and doubles a Builder on its site (or builds on a held site)

combinators.desc: Combinators at work: each makes shortcuts where two links meet, and builds like a Builder

explorers.desc: Explorers at work: each runs free and finds sites and links

sites_held.desc: Sites with one of the team's Anchors on them

sites_total.desc: Sites on the whole map, found or not

room_mb.desc: Megabytes still to build on the sites the team knows that no other team holds: each site builds only up to its size, then it is spent

links_rotting.desc: Of those, the ones under a third of their health

income_kbs.desc: Bytes the team is building on sites, in kilobytes per second, lately

mainframe_connected.desc: Whether the team's origin reaches the mainframe over links it knows, so its hackers can go there and build

hack_pct.desc: The team's progress into the hack: the bytes it has built at the mainframe over the hack's price

leader_pct.desc: The best other team's progress into the hack

threat.desc: Other teams' bots standing on sites the team knows
